description: This file defines the 'Paths' class within the PdfSharp.Features.Drawing namespace, which provides methods for rendering various drawing path snippets into PDF documents, such as curves, miscellaneous paths, shapes, text, and WPF paths.

classes.name: Paths
classes.description: A class that provides methods to render various drawing path snippets into PDF files within the PdfSharp features.

methods.name: PathCurves
methods.description: Renders the 'PathCurves' snippet into a PDF document.

methods.description: Renders the 'PathMisc' snippet into a PDF document.

methods.name: PathShapes
methods.description: Renders the 'PathShapes' snippet into a PDF document.

methods.name: RenderAllSnippets
